note: Literature confirms genotype-phenotype correlations where loss-of-function DHX9 variants produce milder NDD phenotypes, whereas missense variants can lead to more severe NDD or CMT2.

evidence.text: Quantitative HPO analysis demonstrated clear genotype-phenotype correlations in DHX9, where loss-of-function variants caused mild NDD phenotypes, while missense variants caused more severe NDD or altered ATPase activity and intracellular localization.

source.title: Monoallelic variation in DHX9, the gene encoding the DExH-box helicase DHX9, underlies neurodevelopment disorders and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease
source.quote: Quantitative Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) analysis demonstrated genotype-phenotype correlations with LoF variants causing mild NDD phenotypes and nuclear localization signal (NLS) missense variants causing severe NDD.
